# Digital Point LLC

> Managed AI agent operations for $1M-$50M revenue companies. We deploy and operate the AI plus human teams that handle repeatable knowledge work, so businesses scale without scaling headcount.

## What we do

- AI Agents: custom-trained agents we deploy on n8n + Groq + custom TypeScript, then operate continuously. Operators audit the edges where automation breaks.
- Workflow Automation: wire tools, data, and humans together so handoffs happen without manual work.
- Remote Operators: vetted humans layered over the AI for cases automation cannot handle.
- Recovery (category creator): audit broken AI agent stacks, ship the patch, operate it.

## How we charge

- Audit: free. 45-minute call plus a written 5-day plan.
- Recovery Diagnosis: $5,000 over 2 weeks.
- Recovery Fix: $10,000 over 4 weeks.
- Pilot: $2,500 fixed for 30 days.
- Retainer: $2,500 per month, month-to-month.
